value.body: A media planner works out where a brand places its advertising — which channels, programmes, websites or locations — to reach its audience within a budget. Most jobs are in media agencies, advertising agencies and the marketing teams of larger brands. A day involves audience data, spreadsheets, discussions with media sellers and tracking how campaigns are running.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA Marketing, B.Com or BMS; agency trainee programmes

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, audience measurement data, digital ad platforms

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join media agencies as trainees or media executives through campus placement or direct applications, and learn planning on live client accounts. Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets matters as much as interest in advertising.

value.title: At a glance
items: Spend is shifting towards digital, so planners increasingly work with online data.
Next roles: senior planner, media manager, or digital/programmatic specialist.
Agency life can involve long hours around campaign launches.
